name: PSX Trees (27 low-poly PS1-style trees & foliage, CC0)
summary: 27 PS1-style trees and foliage pieces (oaks, pines, willow, palm, dead wood, bushes, ferns, grass, hedge, far-distance billboards) at 6 to 758 triangles each, with tiny 16-colour dithered textures and alpha-clip leaf cards. One GLB per model with embedded textures, plus the PNG textures, previews, contact sheet and a .blend. Ready for Godot, Blender or Unity (glTFast).

access.notes: CC0 stated on the itch page and in the bundled README; no credit required (appreciated).

procedure: Click Download Now, then 'No thanks, just take me to the downloads' (or pay what you want)
Download PSX_Trees_v1.zip (2.4 MB) and drop the .glb files into your engine
Set texture filtering to Nearest and turn mipmaps off for the PS1 look

verdict.why: Fresh CC0 pack, downloaded and checked: 27 GLB + textures + .blend, README confirms CC0 and clean low-tri topology. Useful drop-in set for retro/horror 3D games.
